<thought>To obtain the precursors, I will apply retrosynthetic template 149040 to the product molecule that contains the silyl ether. The product SMILES (without atom‑mapping) is:
`CCOC(=O)CH2C1CC(O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C(C)(C)C(=C(C)C)O1`
Applying the template should break the Si–O bond and return the two reactants: the silyl reagent and the deprotected alcohol.
